title: Can Agentic Systems Close the Gap in Radiology with Production AI Tools?
title_zh: 智能体系统能否借助生产级AI工具弥合放射学差距？

paragraphs.en: Radiology AI has developed along two paths: specialized models that perform well on narrow tasks but cover few clinical findings, and generalist models that address a broader range of tasks but remain prone to hallucination and inaccurate measurements. Combining the two through agentic systems offers a route towards comprehensive radiology reporting, but published systems are tied to one modality or body part. We describe a radiology agentic framework that standardizes how an orchestrator calls modular tools to produce a structured report, and use it to measure what such a system can do with the tools from FDA-cleared radiology AI devices. Report generation is simulated on a large multi-modality report corpus, with the orchestrator given either a catalog of finding classes consolidated from the cleared devices, each available on the modalities it is cleared for, or an unlimited catalog in which any class can be requested, and planning either from the clinical indication or from the target report. Tool outputs are simulated from the reference report, so the comparison isolates tool availability and orchestration from tool error. With the cleared catalog and the indication alone, the orchestrator recovers under a third of the clinically actionable findings; recovery improves substantially with the unlimited catalog, and further when the plan is written from the target report. Attributing every missed finding to a cause shows that most are classes no cleared device offers for the study’s modality, and that a third are classes or tools that were offered and not called. Adding the most frequently missing tools closes most of the gap to the unlimited catalog on held-out reports, whereas a smaller orchestrator with the unlimited catalog gives up the whole gain. Tool availability and effective orchestration are thus complementary constraints on comprehensive AI-assisted radiology reporting.

paragraphs.en: A radiology examination starts with the reading of the images (radiographs, CT, MRI, ultrasound) and ends in a report: a text in which the radiologist states what the images show, what is normal and what it means for the patient, condensing hundreds of observations, many of them made without ever being put into words. Over the past decade, AI in radiology has taken the form of single-purpose devices, each cleared by a regulator for one task on one modality; the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) lists more AI-enabled devices for radiology than for any other specialty [ 20 ] . A report, however, is not one task. Reading a chest CT for cancer staging means surveying the lungs, the pleura, the mediastinum, the vessels, the bones and the upper abdomen, measuring what is found, comparing it with the previous study and weighing the findings together; a tool that detects lung nodules covers one step of that sequence. The question for AI in radiology has therefore moved from whether one finding can be detected to whether a system can assemble many such tools into the reading of a whole study, and this paper measures how far that assembly can go with the tools cleared today.

paragraphs.en: Two kinds of AI tools coexist in radiology. Specialized models (lung nodule detection, liver segmentation, calcium scoring) are accurate within their scope but cannot be composed to cover the thousands of findings that appear in reports, many of which are never named explicitly and emerge from the radiologist’s reading. Vision-language models (VLMs) produce fluent reports but omit findings, hallucinate and measure imprecisely [ 7 , 21 ] ; in 3D CT report generation they also fall back on stereotyped text, a failure described as template collapse [ 15 ] . Agentic systems, in which a large language model (LLM) orchestrator plans and calls tools, combine the two and have outperformed either alone in several settings [ 22 , 24 , 5 , 6 , 3 , 19 , 9 , 2 ] . The published systems are, however, built for one modality or one anatomy with a fixed tool set: chest radiographs [ 5 ] , CT [ 6 ] , PET/CT [ 3 ] , or a radiotherapy pathway [ 8 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 放射学领域存在两类共存的 AI 工具。 专用模型（肺结节检测、肝脏分割、钙化评分）在其范围内准确，但无法组合起来覆盖报告中出现的数千种发现，其中许多从未被明确命名，而是从放射科医生的阅读中产生。 视觉-语言模型（VLM）能生成流畅的报告，但会遗漏发现、产生幻觉且测量不精确 [ 7 , 21 ] ；在 3D CT 报告生成中，它们还会退回到刻板化的文本，这种失败被称为模板坍缩 [ 15 ] 。 智能体系统中，大语言模型（LLM）编排器负责规划并调用工具，将两者结合起来，并且在多种场景下表现优于任一单独使用的方式 [ 22 , 24 , 5 , 6 , 3 , 19 , 9 , 2 ] 。 然而，已发表的系统都是针对单一模态或单一解剖部位、使用固定工具集构建的：胸部 X 光片 [ 5 ] 、CT [ 6 ] 、PET/CT [ 3 ] ，或放疗路径 [ 8 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Our design borrows from the Model Context Protocol (MCP) [ 1 ] , an open standard from the software industry under which a language model discovers and calls external tools and data sources through one common interface, whoever built them, much as a USB port lets any device connect to a computer. On the orchestrator side it follows the ReAct pattern [ 23 ] , in which the model alternates between reasoning about what it has seen so far and acting by calling a tool, each result feeding the next decision, so that a report is produced by a sequence of such cycles over the study rather than by a single generation. We propose a radiology agentic framework with the same shape, a shared interface: a vocabulary of resources (patient context, prior studies, templates, guidelines) and tools (viewer interaction, detection, segmentation, quantification, longitudinal comparison, reporting) that any compliant orchestrator can compose, and that can run against different deployed tool catalogs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的设计借鉴了模型上下文协议（Model Context Protocol，MCP）[1]，这是软件行业的一项开放标准：语言模型通过一个统一接口发现并调用外部工具和数据源，无论这些工具和数据源由谁构建，正如 USB 接口让任何设备都能连接到计算机一样。 在编排器一侧，它遵循 ReAct 模式 [23]：模型在推理（思考目前所见的内容）与行动（调用工具）之间交替进行，每次结果都会输入到下一个决策中，因此报告是通过对研究任务进行一系列这样的循环产生的，而不是通过单次生成完成的。 我们提出了一个具有相同形态的放射学智能体框架，即一个共享接口：一套由资源（患者上下文、既往检查、模板、指南）和工具（查看器交互、检测、分割、定量、纵向对比、报告生成）组成的词汇表，任何符合规范的编排器都可以对其进行组合，并且可以针对不同的已部署工具目录运行。

paragraphs.en: We use the framework to ask what an agentic system can do with the tools cleared for clinical use today. We compare an orchestrator given a tool-infinite catalog, where it can request any plausible tool and finding class, with the same orchestrator restricted to a catalog distilled from the FDA list of AI-enabled devices for radiology: 1,164 cleared devices, consolidated into 1,989 finding classes, each available on the modalities it is cleared for [ 20 ] . Tool outputs are simulated from the reference report in both cases, so the comparison measures tool availability and orchestration rather than tool accuracy. The distance between the two catalogs bounds what new tools could add; the distance between the tool-infinite catalog and the reference report bounds the agentic design itself. We then attribute every finding the cleared-catalog orchestrator misses to a cause, test the simplest fix, adding the most frequently missing tools, on held-out reports, and measure how much of the tool-infinite result depends on the orchestrator model. The evaluation uses PARROT, a corpus of fictional reports across modalities and anatomical regions [ 10 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 我们用该框架来探究：一个智能体系统在今天已获准临床使用的工具条件下能做什么。 我们将两类编排器进行对比：一类是工具无限目录的编排器，它可以请求任何看似合理的工具和征象类别；另一类是相同的编排器，但其工具目录仅限于从 FDA 已批准的放射学 AI 设备清单中提炼而来——1,164 台获批设备，归并为 1,989 个征象类别，每个类别仅在其获批的成像模态上可用 [ 20 ] 。 两种情况下工具输出均基于参考报告进行模拟，因此该对比衡量的是工具可用性与编排能力，而非工具准确性。 两个目录之间的差距界定了新工具所能带来的增益；工具无限目录与参考报告之间的差距则界定了智能体设计本身的局限。 随后，我们将获批目录编排器所遗漏的每一个征象归因于某一原因，在留存报告上测试最简单的修复方法——添加最常缺失的工具，并测量工具无限目录的结果在多大程度上依赖于编排器模型。 评估使用 PARROT，这是一个涵盖多种模态和解剖部位的虚构报告语料库 [ 10 ] 。

sents.en: We then attribute every finding the cleared-catalog orchestrator misses to a cause, test the simplest fix, adding the most frequently missing tools, on held-out reports, and measure how much of the tool-infinite result depends on the orchestrator model.

paragraphs.en: The orchestrator is a pipeline of stages with defined inputs and outputs rather than a single LLM call; together they implement the planning-and-acting loop that earlier systems describe monolithically [ 22 , 24 , 5 , 6 , 3 , 23 ] . The Context Loader reads the patient record, retrieves prior studies and resolves the tools available. The Planner turns the clinical indication and a retrieved template into a flat, ordered list of analysis steps (detection, measurement, comparison) followed by two drafting steps; each drafting step carries a coverage manifest naming, in reporting order, the anatomical regions and observation categories the report must cover. The Grouper partitions the steps into tracks that can run in parallel: steps on the same lesion or series (detect, segment, measure) stay in one sequential track, steps on independent series run concurrently; it adds no steps of its own. One ReAct loop runs per track, executing steps one at a time, distilling tool results into findings, reacting to detection or longitudinal results in the middle of the loop, and stopping when its steps are exhausted or a budget is reached. The Analyzer merges the tracks, reconciles discrepancies and decides whether to proceed, re-group, or replan. The Reporter drafts the report in the template’s sections from the per-track conclusions and measurements. The Reviewer scores the draft against the findings the Reporter used and triggers one in-place rewrite when the score falls below a threshold.
paragraphs.zh: 编排器是由多个具有明确输入与输出的阶段组成的流水线，而非单次LLM调用；它们共同实现了早期系统以整体方式描述的计划-行动循环 [ 22 , 24 , 5 , 6 , 3 , 23 ] 。 上下文加载器读取患者病历，检索既往检查并解析可用的工具。 规划器将临床适应症与检索到的模板转化为一个扁平、有序的分析步骤列表（检测、测量、对比），随后是两个起草步骤；每个起草步骤都附带一份覆盖清单，按报告顺序列出报告必须覆盖的解剖区域和观察类别。 分组器将步骤划分为可并行运行的轨道：同一病灶或同一序列上的步骤（检测、分割、测量）保持在同一条顺序轨道中，独立序列上的步骤则并发运行；它自身不添加任何步骤。 每条轨道运行一个ReAct循环，逐个执行步骤，将工具结果提炼为发现，在循环中途对检测结果或纵向结果作出反应，并在步骤耗尽或达到预算时停止。 分析器合并各轨道，调和差异，并决定是继续执行、重新分组还是重新规划。 报告器根据各轨道的结论和测量结果，按模板的章节起草报告。 审阅者根据报告器所用的发现对草稿进行评分，当评分低于阈值时触发一次就地重写。

paragraphs.en: Classes are extracted from these summaries in two LLM passes. An extractor (gpt-5.4-mini) reads each summary and lists the classes the device outputs, each with a task (detection, segmentation or biomarker), a body system and the modalities it applies to; a second pass re-checks every proposed class against the summary, dropping 415 entries that did not name an output class and renaming 379, which leaves 2,901 classes. A consolidation model (gpt-5.6-sol) then groups classes that name the same imaging concept, one body system at a time, and keeps one name per group ( ablation_zones → \rightarrow ablation_zone , diffusion_anisotropy → \rightarrow fractional_anisotropy , lvesv_a4c → \rightarrow end_systolic_volume ); five rounds produce 912 merges (660 in the first round) and a final catalog of 1,989 classes, each with its body system, task, modalities and the cleared devices that support it.
paragraphs.zh: 通过两次大语言模型（LLM）处理，从这些摘要中提取类别。 一个提取器（gpt-5.4-mini）读取每份摘要，并列出设备输出的类别，每个类别都带有任务类型（检测、分割或生物标志物）、所属身体系统以及适用的模态；第二轮处理根据摘要对每个提议的类别进行复核，剔除了 415 条未指明输出类别的条目，并重命名了 379 条，最终留下 2,901 个类别。 随后，一个合并模型（gpt-5.6-sol）按身体系统逐一将命名相同成像概念的类别归组，并为每组保留一个名称（ablation_zones → \rightarrow ablation_zone、diffusion_anisotropy → \rightarrow fractional_anisotropy、lvesv_a4c → \rightarrow end_systolic_volume）；经过五轮处理共产生 912 次合并（第一轮为 660 次），最终得到包含 1,989 个类别的目录，每个类别都带有其身体系统、任务、模态以及支持它的已通过审核的设备。

paragraphs.en: Generated reports are scored against the reference report with RadMatch [ 4 ] , a finding-level metric. An extractor LLM decomposes both reports into atomic findings, each with a clinical status (normal or abnormal), descriptors, measurements, a longitudinal status and a clinical-significance tier (critical, urgent, notable, routine) adapted from the ACR actionable-reporting framework. A judge LLM groups reference and generated findings that describe the same clinical entity, irrespective of wording; a status conflict (“pleural effusion” versus “no pleural effusion”) is recorded as a status error, and an anatomical-site mismatch as an omission on the reference side and a spurious finding on the generated side. Each matched, omitted or spurious unit inherits the highest tier among its findings. Throughout the paper the headline metric, which we call the RadMatch score , is actionable recall: the share of reference findings at a critical, urgent or notable tier that the generated report recovers. The held-out runs also report actionable precision. The same prompts are used in every condition, and every finding, match and verdict is stored, so the scores can be audited.
paragraphs.zh: 生成的报告使用 RadMatch [ 4 ] 与参考报告进行评分，RadMatch 是一项发现（finding）级别的指标。 一个提取 LLM 将两份报告分解为原子发现，每个发现包含临床状态（正常或异常）、描述词、测量值、纵向状态，以及改编自 ACR 可行动报告框架的临床意义层级（危急、紧急、值得注意、常规）。 一个评判 LLM 将描述同一临床实体的参考发现与生成发现分组，不考虑措辞差异；状态冲突（“胸腔积液”与“无胸腔积液”）被记录为状态错误，解剖部位不匹配则被记录为参考侧的遗漏和生成侧的虚假发现。 每个匹配、遗漏或虚假的单元继承其各发现中最高的层级。 在全文中，我们将称为 RadMatch 分数的核心指标定义为可行动召回率：生成报告所恢复的危急、紧急或值得注意层级的参考发现所占的比例。 留出集运行还报告可行动精确率。 每种条件下都使用相同的提示词，并且每个发现、匹配和判定都会被存储，因此评分可被审计。

paragraphs.en: Each missed finding is adjudicated by one LLM judge (gpt-5.4-mini), which receives the full reference finding list for context, the tool catalog, and the class vocabularies of the detection, segmentation and biomarker tools filtered to the modality of the study, as the orchestrator saw them, and names the tool and class that would have been required to surface the finding. A class therefore counts as available only on the modalities it is cleared for: pleural effusion, for example, is cleared for radiography and ultrasound and is treated as absent on CT. Each judgment falls into one of five causes: (i) not in the catalog for the modality , no class covers the finding on the study’s modality; (ii) offered for the modality, not called , a matching class was in the enum offered to the orchestrator and was never requested; (iii) tool existed, not called , a class-free tool (measurement, viewer interaction) would have surfaced the finding and was not invoked; (iv) needs a new kind of tool , no existing tool shape can produce the finding; (v) no imaging tool could find it (clinical history, demographics, acquisition technique). We call cause (i) the catalog gap and causes (ii) and (iii) the orchestration gap . Each judgment is grounded in the verbatim text of the finding. Running the attribution in the realistic mode, rather than in +Report where the Planner knows the answer, is what allows the two gaps to be separated.
paragraphs.zh: 每一个遗漏的发现由一个 LLM 评审（gpt-5.4-mini）进行裁定，该评审会收到完整的参考发现列表作为上下文、工具目录，以及检测、分割和生物标志物工具的类别词表（按编排器所见的、过滤到该检查模态的版本），并指出本应需要哪个工具和哪个类别才能呈现该发现。 因此，一个类别仅在它被批准适用的模态上才算可用：例如胸腔积液被批准适用于X光摄影和超声，在CT上则被视为不存在。 每个判定归入五种原因之一：(i) 目录中无该模态的类别，即在该检查的模态上没有任何类别覆盖此发现；(ii) 该模态可用但未被调用，即一个匹配的类别在提供给编排器的枚举中存在，却从未被请求；(iii) 工具存在但未被调用，即某个不依赖类别的工具（测量、查看器交互）本可以呈现该发现却未被调用；(iv) 需要一种新型工具，即现有工具形态无法产生该发现；(v) 没有任何影像工具能够发现它（临床病史、人口统计学信息、采集技术）。 我们将原因 (i) 称为目录缺口，将原因 (ii) 和 (iii) 称为编排缺口。 每个判定都基于该发现的逐字原文。 在真实模式下运行归因分析，而不是在 Planner 已知答案的 +Report 模式下运行，正是能够将这两种缺口区分开来的关键。

paragraphs.en: To measure what adding tools buys, the missing tools are mined from the 659 derivation reports only and added to the detection enum of their modality at three cutoffs: at least 10 reports (24 tools), at least 5 (99 tools) and at least 2 (402 tools). The detection list grows from 260, 171, 149 and 137 classes on CT, MR, radiography and ultrasound to 276, 173, 150 and 139 at the first cutoff, 317, 186, 154 and 148 at the second, and 436, 278, 174 and 180 at the third. Each augmented catalog is run in the Cleared+Clinical-Indication mode, with the same orchestrator and prompts, on 100 held-out test reports, a modality-stratified subset (CT 42, MR 26, radiography 20, ultrasound 12); the Cleared and Tool-Infinite modes are rescored on the same 100 reports with the same RadMatch version. We report actionable recall and precision, the gain over the cleared catalog, and the share of the Cleared-to-Tool-Infinite gap closed, ( augmented − Cleared ) / ( Tool-Infinite − Cleared ) (\text{augmented}-\text{Cleared})/(\text{Tool-Infinite}-\text{Cleared}) , with 95% intervals from a paired bootstrap over reports.
paragraphs.zh: 为了衡量添加工具的收益，仅从659份推导报告中挖掘缺失的工具，并按三个截止阈值添加到相应模态的检测枚举中：至少10份报告（24个工具）、至少5份（99个工具）和至少2份（402个工具）。 CT、MR、放射摄影和超声的检测类别数从260、171、149和137增长到第一个截止阈值的276、173、150和139，第二个截止阈值的317、186、154和148，以及第三个截止阈值的436、278、174和180。 每个增强后的目录都在Cleared+Clinical-Indication模式下运行，使用相同的编排智能体（orchestrator）和提示词，在100份留出测试报告（按模态分层的子集：CT 42、MR 26、放射摄影 20、超声 12）上进行；Cleared和Tool-Infinite模式也在相同的100份报告上用相同版本的RadMatch重新评分。 我们报告可行动召回率和精确率、相对于已获批准目录的增益，以及Cleared到Tool-Infinite差距的弥合比例 ( augmented − Cleared ) / ( Tool-Infinite − Cleared ) (\text{augmented}-\text{Cleared})/(\text{Tool-Infinite}-\text{Cleared})，并通过对报告进行配对自助抽样（bootstrap）给出95%区间。

paragraphs.en: Table 3 and Figure 3 show the effect of adding the recurring missing tools. On the 100 held-out reports the cleared catalog scores 0.347 actionable recall (167 of 481 reference findings recovered) and Tool-Infinite 0.580 (282 of 486), a gap of 0.23. Adding the 24 tools missed in at least 10 derivation reports brings recall to 0.434 ( + 0.09 +0.09 , 95% CI + 0.02 +0.02 to + 0.16 +0.16 ), 37% of the gap (CI 8 to 65%). Adding the 99 tools at the ≥ 5 \geq 5 cutoff brings it to 0.519 ( + 0.17 +0.17 , CI + 0.11 +0.11 to + 0.24 +0.24 ), 74% of the gap (CI 51 to 105%). The 402 tools at ≥ 2 \geq 2 bring it to 0.534 ( + 0.19 +0.19 , CI + 0.10 +0.10 to + 0.27 +0.27 ; 80% of the gap), no clear gain over ≥ 5 \geq 5 for four times as many tools: the extra 303 draw calls (1,237 calls to added tools, against 615 at ≥ 5 \geq 5 ) with little change in what is recovered. Actionable precision rises with the first tools and falls back at ≥ 2 \geq 2 (0.386 with the cleared catalog, 0.526 at ≥ 5 \geq 5 , 0.475 at ≥ 2 \geq 2 ); Tool-Infinite scores 0.501.

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 compares the three orchestrators on the same 100 held-out reports in the Tool-Infinite+Clinical-Indication mode. With any class available, gpt-5.4-nano scores 0.355 (174 of 490 actionable findings), 0.225 below gpt-5.6-luna (95% CI − 0.30 -0.30 to − 0.15 -0.15 ) and at the level of luna restricted to the cleared catalog (0.347): its gain over that run is + 0.01 +0.01 (CI − 0.08 -0.08 to + 0.10 +0.10 ). Qwen3.5 9B, run locally, produced no report for 10 of the 100 studies (4 failed at planning, 6 returned an empty report); scoring those as empty, it reaches 0.356 (162 of 455), − 0.22 -0.22 against luna (CI − 0.29 -0.29 to − 0.16 -0.16 ), and 0.413 against 0.600 for luna on the 90 studies it completed ( − 0.19 -0.19 , CI − 0.26 -0.26 to − 0.12 -0.12 ). The orchestrator thus matters as much as the catalog: with every class available, the two smaller models score where luna scores with the cleared catalog, so the headroom that a richer catalog creates is only realized by an orchestrator able to use it. The converse is the promising side of the result: the Tool-Infinite ceiling is set with today’s orchestrator, and future orchestrators may raise it.
paragraphs.zh: 图5比较了三个编排器在Tool-Infinite+Clinical-Indication模式下对同一批100份留出报告的表现。 在所有类别可用的情况下，gpt-5.4-nano得分为0.355（490个可行动发现中命中174个），比gpt-5.6-luna低0.225（95% CI − 0.30 -0.30 至 − 0.15 -0.15），与限制在已获批目录下的luna水平相当（0.347）：其相对该运行的提升为 + 0.01 +0.01（CI − 0.08 -0.08 至 + 0.10 +0.10）。 本地运行的Qwen3.5 9B在100项研究中有10项未生成报告（4项在规划阶段失败，6项返回了空报告）；若将这些计为空报告，其得分为0.356（455个中命中162个），比luna低 − 0.22 -0.22（CI − 0.29 -0.29 至 − 0.16 -0.16）；在其完成的90项研究上，得分为0.413，而luna为0.600（ − 0.19 -0.19，CI − 0.26 -0.26 至 − 0.12 -0.12）。 因此编排器与目录同样重要：当所有类别都可用时，两个较小的模型的得分相当于luna在已获批目录下的得分，说明更丰富目录所创造的提升空间只有能够利用它的编排器才能实现。 反过来看，这也是该结果令人乐观的一面：Tool-Infinite的上限是由当前的编排器设定的，未来的编排器可能会抬高这一上限。

sents.en: With any class available, gpt-5.4-nano scores 0.355 (174 of 490 actionable findings), 0.225 below gpt-5.6-luna (95% CI − 0.30 -0.30 to − 0.15 -0.15 ) and at the level of luna restricted to the cleared catalog (0.347): its gain over that run is + 0.01 +0.01 (CI − 0.08 -0.08 to + 0.10 +0.10 ).
sents.zh: 在所有类别可用的情况下，gpt-5.4-nano得分为0.355（490个可行动发现中命中174个），比gpt-5.6-luna低0.225（95% CI − 0.30 -0.30 至 − 0.15 -0.15），与限制在已获批目录下的luna水平相当（0.347）：其相对该运行的提升为 + 0.01 +0.01（CI − 0.08 -0.08 至 + 0.10 +0.10）。

sents.en: Qwen3.5 9B, run locally, produced no report for 10 of the 100 studies (4 failed at planning, 6 returned an empty report); scoring those as empty, it reaches 0.356 (162 of 455), − 0.22 -0.22 against luna (CI − 0.29 -0.29 to − 0.16 -0.16 ), and 0.413 against 0.600 for luna on the 90 studies it completed ( − 0.19 -0.19 , CI − 0.26 -0.26 to − 0.12 -0.12 ).
sents.zh: 本地运行的Qwen3.5 9B在100项研究中有10项未生成报告（4项在规划阶段失败，6项返回了空报告）；若将这些计为空报告，其得分为0.356（455个中命中162个），比luna低 − 0.22 -0.22（CI − 0.29 -0.29 至 − 0.16 -0.16）；在其完成的90项研究上，得分为0.413，而luna为0.600（ − 0.19 -0.19，CI − 0.26 -0.26 至 − 0.12 -0.12）。

sents.en: The orchestrator thus matters as much as the catalog: with every class available, the two smaller models score where luna scores with the cleared catalog, so the headroom that a richer catalog creates is only realized by an orchestrator able to use it.
sents.zh: 因此编排器与目录同样重要：当所有类别都可用时，两个较小的模型的得分相当于luna在已获批目录下的得分，说明更丰富目录所创造的提升空间只有能够利用它的编排器才能实现。

sents.en: The converse is the promising side of the result: the Tool-Infinite ceiling is set with today’s orchestrator, and future orchestrators may raise it.
sents.zh: 反过来看，这也是该结果令人乐观的一面：Tool-Infinite的上限是由当前的编排器设定的，未来的编排器可能会抬高这一上限。

paragraphs.en: Six in ten misses are classes that no cleared device offers on the study’s modality, and the recurring ones are ordinary: pleural effusion on CT, mediastinal lymphadenopathy, atrophy, bile-duct dilatation, atelectasis, ascites. Adding tools for these recurring findings helps: on held-out reports, 99 tools close most of the gap to the tool-infinite catalog and the next 303 add little. Two caveats: the sample is 100 reports, with an interval of 51% to 105% on the share of the gap closed; and the ceiling is the tool-infinite level, 0.437 actionable recall on the full corpus. Above all, every tool here is perfect: the simulator answers from the reference report, so an added tool never misses, never raises a false alarm and never disagrees with the radiologist, which is far from the clinical situation. The gains measure what the catalog can offer, not what deployed tools would deliver. The catalog is also thin: 59% of its classes rest on a single device, and only 29% of FDA-authorized radiology AI devices reported clinical testing in a recent review [ 17 ] , as in earlier surveys of commercial products [ 11 , 12 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 十分之六的漏检是那些没有任何已获批设备提供该研究模态的类别，且反复出现的都是普通发现：CT上的胸腔积液、纵隔淋巴结肿大、萎缩、胆管扩张、肺不张、腹水。 为这些反复出现的发现添加工具有所帮助：在留出报告上，99个工具已缩小了与工具无限目录之间的大部分差距，接下来的303个工具几乎没有额外贡献。 有两点需要注意：样本仅为100份报告，所弥补差距的比例区间为51%至105%；且上限是工具无限的水平，即整个语料库上0.437的可行动召回率。 最重要的是，这里的每个工具都是完美的：模拟器从参考报告中作答，因此添加的工具从不漏检、从不误报、也从不与放射科医生意见相左，这与临床实际情况相去甚远。 这些增益衡量的是该目录所能提供的，而非已部署工具实际会交付的。 该目录也较为单薄：其59%的类别仅基于单一设备，而且正如早期对商业产品的调查一样，在最近的一项综述中，只有29%的FDA授权放射学AI设备报告了临床测试 [ 17 ] 。

paragraphs.en: In 32% of the misses a cleared tool was offered for the study’s modality and not called: vascular stenosis and aortic calcification in 46 reports each, pleural effusion in 39 on radiography and ultrasound. More classes do not help here. The attribution does not say why, but the uncalled concepts (stenosis, calcification, atherosclerosis, effusion, atrophy) are ones a radiologist checks on most studies whatever the indication, so the Planner’s coverage manifest does not yet produce a systematic survey. Two other results point the same way: with the same unlimited catalog, planning from the report instead of the indication raises recall from 0.437 to 0.740; and with every class available, gpt-5.4-nano and Qwen3.5 9B score where luna scores with the cleared catalog, so that on the same 100 reports the catalog change is worth + 0.23 +0.23 with luna and + 0.01 +0.01 with nano. The orchestrator decides how much a catalog is worth. paragraphs.en: With any tool on demand, perfect simulated outputs and a plan written from the report, actionable recall is 0.740: a quarter of the actionable findings stays out of reach of tool composition. The remainder includes findings that only make sense in combination, lesions that need characterization in context, and descriptions that do not decompose into tool calls; part of it is by construction, since no image-to-text VLM is in the pipeline and whatever cannot be phrased as a tool call is unreachable. A deployed system could instead delegate such steps to a VLM; this fallback is disabled in all experiments so that missing tools remain visible. Radiology is not solved by composing tools, and this remainder is where future orchestrators, and models that read the images themselves, have the most to gain.
paragraphs.zh: 在可按需调用任意工具、模拟输出完美且已根据报告写好计划的情况下，可操作性召回率为 0.740：四分之一的可操作发现仍然无法通过工具组合触及。 其余部分包括只有在组合中才有意义的发现、需要在上下文中进行刻画的病灶，以及无法分解为工具调用的描述；其中一部分是结构性的，因为流水线中没有图像到文本的 VLM，任何无法表述为工具调用的内容都不可触及。 部署的系统可以改为将这类步骤委托给 VLM；在所有实验中该回退机制均被禁用，以便缺失的工具保持可见。 放射学并不能通过组合工具来解决，而这一部分正是未来的编排器和能够自行读取图像的模型最有提升空间之处。

paragraphs.en: PARROT reports are fictional, which gives scale and privacy but is not a proxy for real-world clinical situations [ 10 ] . Evaluation is text-only and every tool call is simulated from the reference report, so tool error is excluded by design and broad classes return more than real detectors would. The held-out runs use 100 reports, enough for the direction of the effect but not to rank the cutoffs. The catalog is a snapshot (FDA decisions to March 2026) built with LLM extraction and consolidation, and the main orchestrator is one model; absolute numbers will move with the model.
paragraphs.zh: PARROT 报告是虚构的，这提供了规模和隐私性，但并不能作为真实临床情况的替代 [ 10 ] 。 评估仅基于文本，且每次工具调用都是从参考报告模拟的，因此设计上排除了工具错误，宽泛的类别返回的结果会多于真实检测器。 留出测试运行使用了 100 份报告，足以判断效应方向，但不足以对各个阈值进行排序。 该目录是一个快照（截至 2026 年 3 月的 FDA 决定），通过 LLM 提取与整合构建而成，且主编排器（orchestrator）为单一模型；绝对数值会随模型而变化。

paragraphs.en: Agentic systems can already compose today’s cleared radiology tools into a report, and this paper measures how far that composition goes. Through a shared interface, an orchestrator planning from the clinical indication recovers close to a third of the actionable findings with the cleared catalog, and more than twice as many when any tool can be requested, with a plan matching the report. Most of the distance between the two is coverage, and adding tools for the recurring missing findings, nearly all of them common, would reduce it; on held-out reports a few dozen such tools close most of that distance, with perfect tool outputs that real tools will not match. The rest is orchestration: even with perfect tools and a perfect plan, a quarter of the actionable findings stays out of reach, underlining the challenges ahead for the next generation of agentic systems.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体系统如今已经能够把现有获批的放射科工具组合成一份报告，本文衡量的是这种组合能走多远。 通过一个共享接口，一个根据临床适应症进行规划的编排器，在使用获批工具目录时可以找回接近三分之一的可操作发现，而在可以请求任意工具时数量翻倍以上，且其计划与报告相符。 两者之间的差距主要在于覆盖率，而为反复缺失的发现——几乎所有都是常见发现——添加工具可以缩小这一差距；在留出报告中，几十个这样的工具就能消除大部分差距，前提是工具输出完美，而真实工具无法达到这一点。 其余差距在于编排：即使拥有完美的工具和完美的计划，仍有四分之一的可操作发现无法企及，这凸显了下一代智能体系统面临的挑战。
